Engagement Record: 2020 02 28 Archive

Carbon Capture and Storage • Durslade & Farnham LLC • Program evaluation phase • 2020-02-28

Executive Summary

This archive entry documents ACPWB's program evaluation phase engagement with Durslade & Farnham LLC in the Carbon Capture and Storage sector. Record ID 0f00af75.

  • The assessment of Durslade & Farnham LLC's ethics hotline found that the average time to close an investigation is 169 days, 47% longer than the best practice benchmark, potentially eroding employee trust in the process.
  • Brand equity tracking methodology assessment confirmed alignment with established Carbon Capture and Storage sector norms across 249 measurement dimensions, with a recommendation to add 42 behavioral and social listening metrics to improve predictive validity relative to 249 peer programs benchmarked as of 2020-02-28.
  • Benefit program cost benchmarking indicated above-median spend in the majority of assessed categories, with highest variance observed in healthcare and retirement provisions.
  • The {phase} analysis revealed that {org}'s total rewards value proposition is positioned at the {percentile} percentile of the {industry} sector, with a recommendation to reallocate {pct}% of the budget from cash incentives to equity to improve long-term alignment.
Key Findings
  • Cluster analysis applied to the 255-organization Carbon Capture and Storage benchmark dataset identifies 20 statistically distinct archetypes, with Durslade & Farnham LLC most closely aligned to the archetype characterized by high associate realization rate (%) investment and above-median governance maturity scores.
  • ACPWB's program evaluation analysis of Durslade & Farnham LLC's pay-for-performance alignment demonstrates a Pearson correlation of 261% between individual performance ratings and actual incentive payouts across 19 fiscal years, a figure that trails the Carbon Capture and Storage sector median by 261 percentage points and informs the compensation committee's design priorities for the forthcoming plan year.
  • The Durslade & Farnham LLC engagement produced 220 actionable recommendations during the program evaluation phase, of which 41 have been fully implemented and 220 remain in progress as of the archival date.

ACPWB's program evaluation work for Durslade & Farnham LLC was structured as a modular engagement, enabling Carbon Capture and Storage sector clients to activate specific analytical components based on their immediate priorities. Durslade & Farnham LLC activated 235 of the 40 available modules, with the remaining modules documented here for potential activation in future engagement phases.

This archive entry documents the support provided to Durslade & Farnham LLC for its annual proxy statement filing. The program evaluation involved drafting the CD&A narrative and validating all compensation tables, with the final filing made on 2020-02-28.

ACPWB's program evaluation enforcement response support engagement with Durslade & Farnham LLC produced 69 analytical work products in connection with regulatory inquiries affecting Durslade & Farnham LLC's Carbon Capture and Storage sector operations. The engagement, structured under outside counsel's direction, covered 21 areas of regulatory focus and produced a remediation framework reviewed by Durslade & Farnham LLC's audit committee on 2020-02-28.

The program evaluation manufacturing workforce benchmarking study documented here assessed Durslade & Farnham LLC's hourly and skilled trades compensation against 81 comparable Carbon Capture and Storage sector employers in 30 geographic markets. ACPWB evaluated shift differentials, overtime practices, and incentive pay structures, delivering findings to Durslade & Farnham LLC's operations and human resources leadership on 2020-02-28.

The program evaluation of the Durslade & Farnham LLC engagement involved a review of the company's compliance with OFCCP regulations. The final report, documenting the affirmative action plan for 2020, was archived on 2020-02-28.

ACPWB's program evaluation engagement with Durslade & Farnham LLC addressed total compensation benchmarking for professional talent in the Carbon Capture and Storage sector. The analysis drew on 60 disclosed contracts and 46 comparable organizational structures to produce market reference ranges reviewed by the Durslade & Farnham LLC front office leadership on 2020-02-28.
